title: MiniCoach — inline micro-actions for cost literacy during rollout setup
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: users configuring model rollouts and capacity commits often lack quick, contextual guidance about the immediate cost impact of toggles (batching, KV cache, quantization). Large doc-driven onboarding interrupts flow. Goal: design a compact, dismissible "MiniCoach" micro-overlay that surfaces a single actionable tip tied to the control the user is interacting with, with a one-tap action (apply suggestion) and a link to deeper docs. The component should be small, non-modal, accessible, localizable, and trackable for analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Tip overlay appears within 200ms of focus/hover on a rollout or capacity control and never covers primary CTA
Each tip includes concise rationale, estimated token cost delta (approx.), and one primary action (Apply Suggestion) plus a secondary link to docs
Users can dismiss a tip for the session or permanently via 'Don't show again' (persisted in account settings)
Analytics events fire on view, apply, dismiss, and learn-more (events must match telemetry schema)
Component meets color contrast AA and keyboard access (focusable, closable by Esc)
Design spec delivered as Figma file and interactive prototype linked in ticket
design_notes: Visual: compact card (360px max width) with icon, single-sentence rationale (<= 100 chars), inline micrometric (e.g., "~10% token cost reduction"), primary button (solid primary, small), secondary text link. Placement: anchored to control's top-right when space allows, otherwise below. Behavior: shows for first two sessions by default; if user applies suggestion auto-annotate rollout as 'optimized'. Localization: allow additional 20% length for translations. Accessibility: aria-describedby on control, role='dialog' avoided; use role='tooltip' when used for hover-only, role='dialog' for interactive action. Edge cases: suppress when in read-only mode or when user has low bandwidth and streaming disabled.
feedback: PM: prefer 'Estimate' wording instead of 'Approx' — clearer for billing conversations
Eng (runtime): request that cost deltas are coarse-grained and computed client-side from existing telemetry buckets to avoid extra calls
Security: avoid exposing exact per-token pricing for enterprise customers — show percentage or tier label instead
Design review: decrease vertical padding and increase hit target on small primary button for mobile

usability_findings_summary: Initial prototype (n=6) showed 4/6 users took immediate action when 'Apply Suggestion' included a quantifiable cost delta. Two participants wanted an explicit 'why this matters' link. Some users worried about persistent tips adding noise; introduced session-based caps and 'Don't show again' control which tested positively.
